class Document:
    def __init__(self, title):
        self.title = title
        self.temp = scratch / (title + \".pdf\")
        self.c = canvas.Canvas(str(self.temp), pagesize=letter, pageCompression=1)
        self.structure = []

    def page(self, label):
        self.structure.append([])
        key = f\"page-{len(self.structure)}\"
        self.c.bookmarkPage(key)
        self.c.addOutlineEntry(label, key)
        self.c.setLineCap(1)
        self.c.setLineJoin(1)

    @contextmanager
    def mark(self, role):
        if role:
            mcid = len(self.structure[-1])
            self.structure[-1].append(role)
            self.c.addLiteral(f\"/{role} <</MCID {mcid}>> BDC\")
        else:
            self.c.addLiteral(\"/Artifact BMC\")
        yield
        self.c.addLiteral(\"EMC\")

    def save(self, filename):
        self.c.save()
        writer = PdfWriter(clone_from=PdfReader(self.temp))
        writer.metadata = None
        writer.add_metadata({\"/Title\": self.title})
        writer.root_object[NameObject(\"/Lang\")] = TextStringObject(\"en-US\")
        writer.root_object[NameObject(\"/MarkInfo\")] = DictionaryObject()
        from pypdf.generic import BooleanObject
        writer.root_object[\"/MarkInfo\"][NameObject(\"/Marked\")] = BooleanObject(True)
        writer.root_object[NameObject(\"/ViewerPreferences\")] = DictionaryObject({
            NameObject(\"/DisplayDocTitle\"): BooleanObject(True)
        })

        def obj(**values):
            return DictionaryObject({NameObject(f\"/{key}\"): value for key, value in values.items()})

        tree = obj(Type=NameObject(\"/StructTreeRoot\"))
        tree_ref = writer._add_object(tree)
        writer.root_object[NameObject(\"/StructTreeRoot\")] = tree_ref
        doc = obj(Type=NameObject(\"/StructElem\"), S=NameObject(\"/Document\"), P=tree_ref, K=ArrayObject())
        doc_ref = writer._add_object(doc)
        tree[NameObject(\"/K\")] = doc_ref
        nums = ArrayObject()

        for index, (page, roles) in enumerate(zip(writer.pages, self.structure)):
            page[NameObject(\"/StructParents\")] = NumberObject(index)
            page[NameObject(\"/Tabs\")] = NameObject(\"/S\")
            section = obj(Type=NameObject(\"/StructElem\"), S=NameObject(\"/Sect\"), P=doc_ref,
                          Pg=page.indirect_reference, K=ArrayObject())
            section_ref = writer._add_object(section)
            doc[\"/K\"].append(section_ref)
            for mcid, role in enumerate(roles):
                element = obj(Type=NameObject(\"/StructElem\"), S=NameObject(f\"/{role}\"),
                              P=section_ref, Pg=page.indirect_reference, K=NumberObject(mcid))
                section[\"/K\"].append(writer._add_object(element))
            nums.extend([NumberObject(index), ArrayObject(section[\"/K\"])])
        tree[NameObject(\"/ParentTree\")] = writer._add_object(obj(Nums=nums))
        tree[NameObject(\"/ParentTreeNextKey\")] = NumberObject(len(self.structure))
        writer.write(filename)

    def line(self, x, y, value, size=14, font=\"Regular\", color=INK, role=\"P\", align=\"left\"):

    def lines(self, x, y, strings, size, leading, font=\"Regular\", color=INK, role=\"P\", align=\"left\"):
        with self.mark(role):
            self.c.setFont(font, size)
            self.c.setFillColor(color)
            draw = {\"left\": self.c.drawString, \"center\": self.c.drawCentredString,
                    \"right\": self.c.drawRightString}[align]
            for index, value in enumerate(strings):
                span = pdfmetrics.stringWidth(value, font, size)
                start = x if align == \"left\" else x - span * (1 if align == \"right\" else 0.5)
                if start < LEFT - 0.1 or start + span > RIGHT + 0.1:
                    raise ValueError(f\"Text crosses margin: {value}\")
                draw(x, H - y - index * leading, value)

    def box(self, x, y, w, h, fill=white, outline=None, radius=12):
        with self.mark(None):
            self.c.setFillColor(fill)
            self.c.setStrokeColor(outline or fill)
            self.c.setLineWidth(0.8)
            self.c.roundRect(x, H - y - h, w, h, radius, fill=1, stroke=bool(outline))

    def rule(self, x, x2, top, color=RULE, width=0.8):

            self.c.setLineWidth(width)

    def icon(self, species, x, top, size, ink, fill):
        with self.mark(None):
